title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best spots on APU's East and West campuses to relax, study, or socialize without spending a dime, from peaceful prayer gardens to lively game rooms.

cards.title: Hang Out at the Cougar Dome
cards.subtitle: East Campus Student Union
cards.notes: Visit this lively hub on East Campus to play free games of ping pong, pool, or basketball. It is a popular social spot for both commuters and residents to unwind between classes.
cards.short_summary: A central student lounge on East Campus featuring free recreational games and social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cougar Dome offers free recreational equipment including a pool table, ping pong table, and basketball court for student use.
cards.source_title: APU Student Union: Study, Relax, & Connect on Campus
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–6 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Relax in Mary Hill Garden
cards.subtitle: West Campus Prayer Garden
cards.notes: Find tranquility in this landscaped garden located between the Felix Event Center and Mary Hill Building. It features a flower wall and a prominent cross for quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor prayer garden on West Campus ideal for quiet breaks and meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Hill garden is a favorite spot for students seeking a quiet, peaceful atmosphere and a view of the flower wall and cross.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space on West Campus.

cards.title: Watch Turtles at the Pond
cards.subtitle: East Campus Amphitheater
cards.notes: Head to the Wynn Amphitheater to observe the resident turtles in the pond. The terraced seating nearby is a great spot to soak up the sun or read a book between classes.
cards.short_summary: A scenic turtle pond located within the terraced seating of the Wynn Amphitheater on East Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The turtle pond in Wynn Amphitheater is a favorite spot for students to observe animals and take a breather.
cards.source_title: 10 Places to Relax on the APU Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area open to the public.

cards.title: Pray in Hartwig Chapel
cards.subtitle: East Campus Sanctuary
cards.notes: Enter this intimate 24-hour chapel for a moment of silence. The space is filled with scripture and artwork, providing a dedicated environment for prayer and reflection.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet prayer space on East Campus featuring religious artwork and scripture.
cards.evidence_claim: Hartwig Prayer Chapel is a 24-hour place of quiet prayer adjacent to Smith Hall.
cards.source_title: 10 Places to Relax on the APU Campus
cards.access_notes: Available 24 hours a day for students and staff.

cards.title: Create at the MakerSpace
cards.subtitle: Marshburn Library Resource
cards.notes: Use free supplies like paint, Cricut machines, and sewing machines to work on creative projects. Librarians provide guides to help you master the more complex equipment.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided creative space in the library offering free access to crafting and fabrication tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The MakerSpace provides students free access to supplies ranging from paint and Cricut machines to a laser engraver and sewing machine.
cards.source_title: Student Resources: APU Libraries Inspire Creativity, Collaboration, and Community
cards.access_notes: Located in Marshburn Library; check library hours for access.

cards.title: Study in Duke Commons
cards.subtitle: West Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Relax on the small sofas or the upstairs balcony in this modern facility. It offers a mall-style food court atmosphere with plenty of seating for group study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern student commons on West Campus with diverse seating areas and a balcony.
cards.evidence_claim: Duke Commons offers many sitting areas, small sofas, tables, and an upstairs balcony where students sit to do homework.
cards.source_title: A Tale of Two Campuses: East vs. West
cards.access_notes: Open to students during building operating hours.

cards.title: Play Sports at Dillon Complex
cards.subtitle: East Campus Athletic Fields
cards.notes: Join a pickup game of volleyball or basketball at this outdoor complex. It is the home of intramural sports and a great place to blow off steam with friendly competition.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor athletic complex on East Campus featuring volleyball and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Dillon Recreation Complex includes volleyball courts, a turf field, and a full basketball court for student use.
cards.source_title: 10 Places to Relax on the APU Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courts are generally available when not in use by intramural teams.

cards.title: Ride the Bus for Free
cards.subtitle: Student Transportation Perk
cards.notes: Get unlimited free rides on Foothill Transit buses all year. Pick up your pass at the Cougar Dome with your student ID to explore the San Gabriel Valley without a car.
cards.short_summary: A university-sponsored program providing students with free unlimited local bus transportation.
cards.evidence_claim: Foothill Transit and APU give students unlimited, FREE RIDES on Foothill Transit buses all school year with a student ID.
cards.access_notes: Passes are distributed at the Cougar Dome on East Campus.

cards.title: Find a Nook in Stamps Library
cards.subtitle: West Campus Study Space
cards.notes: Escape to this quiet library on West Campus to find a cozy couch or a secluded nook. It is known for its peaceful atmosphere, perfect for deep focus and heavy reading.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, book-filled library on West Campus offering comfortable couches and secluded study spots.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamps Theological Library is described by students as a quiet spot with couches and nooks for productive work.
cards.source_title: APU Students' and Alumni's Favorite Spots On Campus
cards.access_notes: Check library website for current academic year hours.

cards.title: Hike the Garcia Trail
cards.subtitle: Nearby Mountain Trail
cards.notes: Take a short, strenuous hike up to the 'A' for a bird's-eye view of the APU campus and the San Gabriel Valley. The trailhead is easily accessible from the university.
cards.short_summary: A popular local hiking trail offering panoramic views of the campus and surrounding valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Many APU students hike nearby Garcia Trail in the San Gabriel Mountains for a bird's-eye view of the campus.
cards.source_title: Things to Do Near Azusa Pacific University – Around Los Angeles
cards.access_notes: Public trail; check local conditions for trail closures.
